# Week 2

## Video 1

```{R}
library(UsingR)
y <- father.son$sheight
# print(y)
print(mean(y))
class(y)
```

```{R}
N <- length(y)
N
Y <- matrix(y, N, 1)
head(Y)
A <- matrix(1, N, 1)
head(A)
barY <- t(A) %*% Y / N ### equivalent to
# barY <- crossprod(A,Y)/N
print(barY)
class(barY)
```

```{R}
r <- y - as.vector(barY)
crossprod(r) / (N - 1)

var(y)
```

```{R}
library(UsingR)
x <- father.son$fheight
y <- father.son$sheight
X <- cbind(1, x)
head(X)
betahat <- solve(t(X) %*% X) %*% t(X) %*% y
### or
betahat <- solve(crossprod(X)) %*% crossprod(X, y)
print(betahat)
```
